# IT Password Reset

> SAMPLE CONTENT for development and evals. Not a real company process.

## Resetting your laptop password

1. Open the self-service portal from the link on the intranet home page.
2. Choose "Reset laptop password" and verify your identity with the one-time code sent to your phone.
3. Set a new password of at least 14 characters. Reuse of the last 10 passwords is blocked.

## Locked accounts

After five failed attempts the account locks for 15 minutes. Contact the IT helpdesk if the lock persists.
